senses.gloss: m. (גרד) wool-dresser, in gen. common weaver, diff. fr. טַרְסִי. [Our w. adopted in Greek a. Latin γέρδιος, gerdius.] B. Bath. 21ᵃ one of the inmates of a court הרוצה לעשות … ג׳ that wants to open a business as … weaver.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 12:4">Kel. XII, 4</cite> <he>מסמר הג׳</he> the weaver’s pin (of the shuttle).

<cite ref="Shabbat 93b:5">Sabb. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>קנה של ג׳</he> the weaver’s cane (quill); Y. ib. X, 12ᶜ bot. <he>גיר׳</he>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>גַּרְדִּיִּים</he>, <cite ref="C01276"><he>גַּרְדִּין</he></cite>.
